description: Answer an agreement using the private confirmation capability received from its issuer. The first valid answer stands; identical repeats return the same record. This records the holder answer only, not identity or performance. Never publish the capability. The issuer hands over certificate_id and capability, or a confirm link where ref is certificate_id and the part after #c= is capability. A disputed answer may include a reason of at most 300 characters.
name: commitment_confirm
